description: A segmented control for one exclusive choice that becomes a native select on mobile.
overview:
`SegmentPicker` presents a small set of mutually exclusive options, such as a time period or a view mode. On desktop it renders a suiss/ui `ToggleGroup` in which exactly one segment stays pressed; clicking the pressed segment keeps it selected. On mobile (below `48rem`, via `useIsMobile`) it renders a `NativeSelect` so the choice fits narrow screens and uses the platform picker.

Each `SegmentPickerItem` becomes a toggle on desktop and an `option` on mobile. Use it for two to five short options that change how content is displayed.
usage:
- The value is uncontrolled by default; use `defaultValue`, or `value` with `onValueChange` to control it. `onValueChange` fires only when the selection changes.
- Without a value, no segment is pressed and the mobile select shows an empty disabled option.
- On mobile each option shows `label`, then `aria-label`, then string children, then `value`. Give icon-only segments an `aria-label`, and segments with mixed content a `label`.
- `variant` and `spacing` apply only on desktop. On mobile, `lg` falls back to the default size.
- With `name`, desktop renders a hidden input so the value is submitted with a form.

examples.WithIconsAndText: Combines icons and text, with `label` for the mobile option text.
examples.Controlled: Owns the value in state with `value` and `onValueChange`.

parts.SegmentPicker: The root that renders the toggle group or native select and holds the value.
parts.SegmentPickerItem: One option, rendered as a toggle on desktop and an `option` on mobile.

SegmentPicker.defaultValue: The initially selected value when uncontrolled.
SegmentPicker.onValueChange: Called with the new value when the user selects a different segment.
SegmentPicker.variant: The visual style of the desktop segments.
SegmentPicker.size: The control size; `lg` maps to the default size on mobile.
SegmentPicker.spacing: The gap between desktop segments; `0` joins them.
SegmentPicker.id: The ID of the group on desktop or the select on mobile.
SegmentPicker.name: The field name submitted with a form.
SegmentPicker.className: Classes applied to the group on desktop or the select on mobile.
SegmentPicker.aria-label: The accessible name of the control.
SegmentPicker.aria-describedby: The ID of an element that describes the control.

SegmentPickerItem.value: The value selected by this segment.
SegmentPickerItem.label: Text for the mobile option, and the desktop content when there are no children.
SegmentPickerItem.className: Classes applied to the desktop toggle.
SegmentPickerItem.children: The desktop segment content, such as text or an icon.
SegmentPickerItem.aria-label: The accessible name of the segment, also used as mobile option text.

accessibility:
- On desktop the root is a `group` named by `aria-label`, and each segment is a button with `aria-pressed`.
- Disabled segments are disabled buttons and cannot be selected.
- On mobile the control is a native `select`.
notes: Styling hooks: `data-slot="segment-picker"` and `segment-picker-item`. `SegmentPickerItem` throws when used outside `SegmentPicker`.
